## Parse Transaction

Single Responsibility: turn raw intake payload (free text from SMS/Telegram, or pre-structured fields from Manual/CSV) into a draft transaction shape. This is a generic, bank-agnostic heuristic parser — a deliberate parallel implementation to the app's own bank-specific `importService.processSms()`, built at explicit request even though it duplicates that logic. Extend the regexes here as needed; it will not track improvements made to the app's parser.

Input: { source: 'SMS'|'TELEGRAM'|'MANUAL', rawText: string, receivedAt?: ISOString, chatId?: string, senderHint?: string } — OR pre-structured { source, amount, description, date?, type?, currency? } which skips heuristic parsing entirely.

Output: { source, rawText, receivedAt, chatId, senderHint, amount, currency, description, date, type, confidence (0-1), parseOk, parseNotes }

Always forwards to 02 - Processing / Validate Transaction — even on parseOk=false, so validation failure messaging stays centralized in one place.
